description: This file defines an interface IServiceRuntimeWrapper and its implementation ServiceRuntimeWrapper, which wraps the Microsoft.WindowsAzure.ServiceRuntime SDK to enable reflection-based access to Azure service runtime information and events in Orleans hosted environments.

classes.name: IServiceRuntimeWrapper
classes.description: Interface providing access to Azure role environment properties and events such as deployment ID, instance name, role name, IP endpoints, configuration settings, and stopping notifications.

classes.name: ServiceRuntimeWrapper
classes.description: Internal class that wraps the Azure Service Runtime SDK via reflection to access runtime info and control role life-cycle events without compile-time dependencies.

methods.name: GetIPEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the IP endpoint for a given endpoint name by querying the role instance endpoints.

methods.name: GetConfigurationSettingValue
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration setting value from Azure environment.

methods.name: SubscribeForStoppingNotification
methods.description: Subscribes an event handler for the role stopping notification event.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStoppingNotification
methods.description: Unsubscribes an event handler from the role stopping notification event.
